fact: The Department of Home Affairs told the Portfolio Committee on Home Affairs, in its fourth quarter 2025/26 performance briefing, that the target for automated birth registration was not achieved, delays being attributed to legal, procurement and interdepartmental processes, while progress was reported on online birth registration and 174 649 births were registered within 30 calendar days in the quarter.
title: Asylum Seeker backlog & refusal of new applications; DHA Q4 2025/26 Performance; with Deputy Minister
